title: Reply discipline: the architect's report as an act the harness checks
situation: Two cuts tried to hold the architect's reply values (conclusion first, at most one action per topic, no menu, no hand-back, record before reporting): first with guards on replies, which 0106 showed cannot hold a reply already shown, then with its own text, which passed visible examples but not held-out ones after hundreds of runs. Under 0106 a guard holds what it checks before it takes effect.
decision: Recommended: the architect's report to the operator becomes an act: a report capability whose typed deliverable holds, per topic, its outcome, at most one recommended action and its support, checked by the harness before anything is shown and rendered in the bottom-line-up-front order, so the structure holds by construction and only its content is judged by examples; free conversation stays free. The alternative is lowering ordering from fixed to firm and measuring its rate. This changes how every architect reply reads, so it waits for the operator's agreement.
consequences: Agreed, it becomes the reply-discipline cut, after the contracts cut, with the examples carried under 0123.
